searchText: Would anyone object to Lighthouse removing the `--network pyrmont` flag? It removes a `BeaconState` from the binary, removing it offers a tangible improvement. Anyone who *really* likes Pyrmont can just revert the commit and build as usual. here's the PR: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/2543

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content:
Would anyone object to Lighthouse removing the `--network pyrmont` flag? It removes a `BeaconState` from the binary, removing it offers a tangible improvement.

Anyone who *really* likes Pyrmont can just revert the commit and build as usual.
